en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4412 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said:

"It is disliked for a man to approach his wife after having experienced a nocturnal emission (wet dream) until he has performed ghusl (ritual purification) from that emission. If he does so and the child is born with a mental disorder, he should blame none but himself."
